description: This file defines a VersionAPI class that extends an abstract REST controller to provide an endpoint for retrieving software version information, specifically interacting with migration data.

classes.name: VersionAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller that provides version information, mainly for upgrade purposes within the installer.

methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of migration versions, optionally excluding the latest version.
